summary: The monocoque timing + facts adjudication is complete and lands per the packet's stop condition 1. The OCC baseline is green and deterministic: five serial quiet-machine runs of f1/monocoque through the door's occ regime (door_version 1) each produced solid_count 2, volume 634804090.9180949, bbox [[-1981.2766075073669, -396.69746881621256, 103.69655901288232],[700.0000001000002, 396.69746881621836, 949.883519840629]], and a 6971-triangle STL - byte-for-byte the recorded reference corpus/ttc/reference/monocoque.json facts (the OCC side of the facts gate is green). The segmentation is the interesting result on this model: the OCC build is ~42.1 s median of which ~36.5 s median is the BOOLEAN stage (2 boolean ops observed - the cavity cut of the lofted tub skin and the 14-body proud-boss fuse), ~5.6 s construction, ~0.20 s tessellation at deflection max(diag*2e-4, 0.01). The kernel (truck) engine refuses on the tub TYPED before any geometry fact exists: Refused 'Plane algebra is recorded client-layer data; no kernel row' with payload {case: unsupported_envelope, envelope: non_canonical_carrier} - the tub's lofted-skin/cavity/boss authoring goes through Plane/spline section faces that are not kernel-engine census carriers, so the cross-engine facts-match gate is RED and no kernel timing is published (no tuning). docs/TT_TIMING_RESULTS.md carries the monocoque table: OCC column measured (three segments, raw samples + medians retained) and the kernel column recorded as DNF-KERNEL with the refusal verbatim.
notes: write_allow was docs/TT_TIMING_RESULTS.md only, which the packet honours: the file is created (it was missing at dispatch; TTC-TIMING-FH has not run, so this is the file's first table). Protocol followed the FH template inline in PACKET.md: release regime, quiet machine (measured in a window with no concurrent cargo/rustc on the autobuild farm), one fresh python process per run, five measured runs, median reported, DNF rows kept, no cross-row averages, raw samples retained. The measured runs used an observer harness (temp, outside the worktree) that reproduces the door exactly - cadgen alias to genuine build123d 0.11.1 (cadquery-ocp 7.9.3.1.1), the lib.monocoque.build_monocoque entry, the facts record, the deflection rule, and export_stl - and splits the build wall into construction vs boolean by timing only the Shape.fuse/Shape.cut verbs the UNMODIFIED corpus script reaches (observation only, geometry untouched). The truck-engine run used the door's --engine truck regime (door_version 2) over a release-built truck123d native module (truck123d.dll staged as truck123d.pyd beside the interpreter runtimes, the pyo3 3.14 abi-3-unlinked extension). The kernel refusal is reproducible and verbatim-recorded. A single fresh door --engine occ cross-check run reproduced the identical facts and 6971 triangles (build_seconds 45.093). The corpus documents OCC trouble on this class (Null TopoDS_Shape 1-in-3 under 4-way concurrency); all serial quiet runs here were green and deterministic.
